synthesizedFacts.fact: Oily skin requires moisturization to maintain skin barrier function and prevent overproduction of sebum.
Non-comedogenic moisturizers are formulated to not clog pores, which is crucial for oily skin types.
Ingredients like perlite, silica, and starches can help absorb excess oil and provide a mattifying effect.
The comedogenicity scale is not an exact science and should be used as a guideline rather than a definitive measure.
